client_brief:
Lumen Quarterly's autumn issue, with an editable layout and recovered masthead

The editor will still be moving copy close to publication. Lumen Quarterly needs an autumn issue document that remains genuinely editable, supported by a coherent fourteen-frame photo essay and a usable version of our scanned masthead.

Final handoff

 Autumn editorial issue: 1 named export. The complete approved article is present. The image order follows the editorial sequence: the running order of lumen_platecard_roster.csv, row by row. The masthead preserves the approved lettering of our scanned printed cover, not re-set in another face, and heads page 1, the cover. The page hierarchy supports sustained reading. The essay headline follows the house type system, sentence case included.

 Editorial plate card: 15 named exports. The plate caption matches this record. If this record names a supplied picture, that picture appears on the card; otherwise the card contains no invented image.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: An independent arts and culture quarterly, published four times a year around one long photo essay and its writing.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Published by Lumen House Press, a two person imprint in Portland, Maine, founded 2016.
brand_identity.about: Lumen Quarterly is a print magazine about art, craft and the people who make things along the coast. Each issue turns on one photo essay and about two thousand words of reporting. Readers pay for it because it is good to hold and worth keeping on a shelf, not for news.
brand_identity.audience: Design literate readers aged 30 to 55 who buy the object as much as the article and renew a subscription because the magazine is made with care.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Eighteen dollars a single copy, sixty dollars a year. An independent object priced above a newsstand title and below an art book, sold on typographic craft rather than volume.

palette.name: Uncoated Paper
palette.usage: The ground of every page of the issue and of every plate card, as on lumen_spring_issue_press.pdf and lumen_platecard_template.pdf; the only solid ground.

palette.name: Masthead Ink

palette.usage: Body text, the standfirst and captions in the issue, and the caption sentence on each card, as on lumen_spring_issue_press.pdf and lumen_platecard_template.pdf; it may also carry an issue caption's credit line, set with its caption. Never a ground or panel.

palette.name: Rule Grey
palette.role: mandatory for folios and hairline rules, and for the credit line and issue line on each plate card
palette.usage: Hairline rules and folios (lumen_style_guide.pdf: "Rule Grey carries hairlines and folios."), and the credit line and the issue line on each plate card, as on lumen_platecard_template.pdf. An issue caption's credit line may be Rule Grey or Charcoal, since lumen_spring_issue_press.pdf prints no credit lines. Never a ground, panel, body text or caption.

palette.name: Signal Ochre
palette.role: mandatory as the standfirst tint band; otherwise an optional accent
palette.usage: The band behind the standfirst over lumen_autumn_essay_01.jpg, the essay's opening photograph, at 20% opacity, as on lumen_spring_issue_press.pdf; pull-quote marks in the issue; the hairline plate rule on each card, as on lumen_platecard_template.pdf. Never text other than pull-quote marks, a ground or a panel.

brand_identity.typography: Lumen Quarterly runs four steps. Step 01, display, is the masthead: Epilogue Black caps at 64 pt on 68 pt leading, letterspaced to roughly +180 units so the word spans the exact measure of the text column, with QUARTERLY beneath in Epilogue Medium caps at a quarter of that cap height tracked to the identical width so both lines start and end flush, always flush left and never centred. Step 02, subheading, is the essay opener in Epilogue Black at 40 pt on 44 pt with -5 tracking, flush left and never letterspaced to the measure. Step 03, body, is Arnhem Blond at 10 pt on 15 pt with tracking 0, set to the house 62 character measure. Step 04, fine print, is Arnhem Blond at 8 pt on 12 pt with +15 tracking for captions and plate lines, with plate numerals left Roman.
brand_identity.voice: Considered, warm and exact, written like an essay rather than a pitch. Example line the brand would write: He has built the same hull the same way for forty years, and he still stops to look at the grain before the first cut.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The house style guide was made by the magazine's first designer, who has left, and it is now a couple of issues out of date on type. The masthead artwork inside the guide is a flattened screenshot, so the only proper record of the wordmark is the printed cover, which has been scanned. The printer also returned last season's press file.
brand_identity.values: Every issue should feel like the same magazine. Continuity of type, measure and picture treatment is the identity, and the reader should recognise Lumen before reading a word.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: The masthead is always two letterspaced lines locked to one width, LUMEN in Epilogue Black over QUARTERLY in Epilogue Medium at a quarter of the cap height, both starting and ending flush.

scale.tracking: letterspaced to the exact measure of the text column, roughly +180 units at this size, all caps
scale.note: The masthead. QUARTERLY sits directly beneath in Epilogue Medium caps at a quarter of that cap height, tracked to the identical width so both lines start and end flush. The tracking on both lines is whatever locks them to the column measure, so it is re-cut whenever the measure changes. Always flush left, never centred.

type_system.signature_move: The stacked masthead. LUMEN in Epilogue Black caps at 64 pt on 68 pt, letterspaced until it spans the exact measure of the text column, with QUARTERLY beneath in Epilogue Medium caps at a quarter of that cap height, tracked to the identical width so both lines start and end flush. Two spaced lines locked to one width, always flush left, is what a reader knows before reading a word.
rules: The masthead is always two letterspaced lines locked to one width, LUMEN in Epilogue Black over QUARTERLY in Epilogue Medium at a quarter of the cap height, both starting and ending flush.
LUMEN is letterspaced until it spans the exact measure of the text column, so the tracking is re-cut whenever the measure changes.
The essay sets to a 62 character measure.
Epilogue is display only. The essay, captions and plate lines are always Arnhem Blond.
Continuity of type, measure and picture treatment is the identity. Every issue must set to the same four steps.

palette_rules.distribution: Every ground is Uncoated Paper or a photograph; no palette colour fills a page, panel or card ground. Masthead Ink carries the masthead, headline, byline, pull quotes and each card's plate numeral and title; Charcoal carries body text, the standfirst and captions; Rule Grey carries hairlines and folios, and on the cards the credit line and issue line; an issue caption's credit line is Rule Grey or Charcoal; Signal Ochre carries only the standfirst band and pull-quote marks in the issue and the plate rule on the cards, as on lumen_spring_issue_press.pdf and lumen_platecard_template.pdf. Rule Grey and Signal Ochre together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, the standfirst band aside.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, with no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph. One exception, which lumen_spring_issue_press.pdf already prints: a band of Signal Ochre #B4762E at 20% opacity behind the standfirst. In autumn-issue.pdf it sits over lumen_autumn_essay_01.jpg, the essay's opening photograph. Nowhere else, and never on a plate card.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes (#F3EEE3, #1F3A3C, #26262A, #9C968B and #B4762E) for type, rules, panels or icons; no brightened version of any ink (lumen_style_guide.pdf: "Ink on uncoated; do not brighten."); no tint or transparency other than the standfirst band.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward a palette colour. lumen_style_guide.pdf: "One light per feature" and "Warm, unhurried. No HDR look, no crushed blacks." The blown window in lumen_autumn_essay_02.jpg stays as photographed and is never filled with Uncoated Paper, another palette colour or invented detail.
